en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad .b Muhammad b. `Isa narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from `Anbasa al-`Abid from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as).
He said: Beware of arguing in religion, for it distracts the heart from the remembrance of Allah, it bequeaths hypocrisy, it forms grudges, and it makes lying easy.
